answer: Each identity posts a 70-credit bond and registers one copper anchor, key-bound, at the summit registry. It activates with a signed ascent receipt: anchor weighed at the summit this epoch against the weight table. Auditors re-weigh 1 in 8; a reused serial, a weight off by 3%, or a missed window burns the bond. First ascent 38, k-th 38+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,534,500. Lift-sharing rings fail: one receipt per anchor. An honest agent pays 38 once.
